summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V, a SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding a Forward Purchase Agreement with HB Strategies LLC for an OTC prepaid share forward transaction in connection with its proposed business combination with Teamshares Inc. The agreement provides for up to 4,000,000 Subject Shares, with the Prepayment Amount equal to shares times the Initial Price set five business days pre-closing, funded from the trust account after redemptions. No board recommendation or advisors named. This mechanism supports the de-SPAC by injecting capital, reducing redemption risk. Watch the shareholder vote on the merger agreement and any redemption levels for risk-arb spread.
